systems.owner: Ministère des Transports, with unnamed technical partners
systems.tiers: Enrolment centres in Grand Libreville; the Akanda centre closed temporarily in April 2026 and in May 2026 enrolment was entrusted to the 'mairie centrale' to absorb the commune's applicants; all enrolment suspended from 21 September 2026

note: The transport ministry's digital driving-licence enrolment (launched 24 March 2026, suspended six months later) used the central town hall as an enrolment site from May 2026; the article does not say the town hall's own staff worked in the system or how the site was connected, so no connection fact is taken.
